title: Tessellate Sync 4.2 Release Notes
key_sentences: Version 4.2 introduces selective sync rules and a command-line report of sync conflicts.
It also makes the first sync of large folders up to three times faster.
This release is a free update for all customers with an active subscription.
You can now choose which files are synced by listing include and exclude patterns in a rules file.
The following settings still work in 4.2 but print a warning at start-up.
If you manage clients centrally, the MSI package accepts the same command-line options as version 4.1.

rows: none; TLS 1.2 or later is required

list_items.text: • Faster first sync on large folders:
– the initial scan now runs on four threads by default;
– unchanged files are skipped by size and modification time before hashing.
• The tray icon shows the number of files still waiting to upload.
– the proxy can be read from the operating system settings.
TS-2291: renaming a folder while offline no longer duplicates its contents.
TS-2304: file names with trailing spaces are synced on all platforms.
TS-2317: the client no longer stops when the disk is almost full; it pauses and warns instead.
TS-2342: shared links keep their expiry date after the file is edited.
Close the client on every device that uses the account.
Install version 4.2 over the existing installation; settings are kept.
Start the client and move any sync.ignore_file patterns into rules.yaml.

notes: Software release notes. Running title (top centre) and "N · Tessellate Sync 4.2" (bottom right) are CSS page-margin boxes; the page-number lines are listed once per page. Two code blocks in Courier New (a YAML rules file and a terminal session with aligned columns; spacing inside code is exact). Inline code words are Courier New as well. Improvements: TYPED "•" bullets with a nested level of TYPED en-dash "–" markers, both with hanging indents. Fixed issues: square bullets drawn by CSS. Upgrading: decimal numbers drawn by CSS. Compatibility table has NO lines at all (no rules, no fills). Deprecated-settings table: filled header and zebra bands, no rules.
